versions.content: Delegation ports on a RootSwCompositionPrototype for which no DataMapping exists (i.e. no variant DataMapping is enabled) shall be con- sidered unconnected because no path exists to a designated SystemSignal . Since this is a delegation port all enabled delegation connectors linking SWC R-ports to the respective delegation port must be considered unconnected (see section 5.2.7). P- Ports shall behave as documented in section 4.7.3.1.2.
